name: Horizontal Blinds Transition
description: Pinned full-screen scroll sequence where each image is revealed through rows of horizontal blinds that open in sequence, with animated captions and a segmented progress bar.
contents: Full-screen image slides with index counter, kicker pill, title and description
Segmented progress bar at the bottom
behavior: Section is pinned with a sticky stage and its height is 100vh per slide
SVG mask strips open in a staggered sequence driven by scroll scrub
Captions wipe in with clip-path and out upward between slides
editableByProps: Number of slides, images, kickers, titles and descriptions
Number of blinds, scroll smoothing and scrub amount

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the blind opening easing or stagger

needsCodeEdit.where: filter brightness(0.75) style on the image element

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with Lenis, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Registers a GSAP ScrollTrigger and ticker callback, removed on unmount
Loads Playfair Display and Space Mono from Google Fonts through a link added to document head
Stage height is 100vh per slide to give the pin scroll room
